thread.title: Trump Today: President suggests China trade deal could happen soon as he praises Apple for expanding in U.S.

author: Robert Schroeder
title: Trump Today: President suggests China trade deal could happen soon as he praises Apple for expanding in U.S.
text:
AFP/Getty Images China's President Xi Jinping, left, and President Donald Trump President Donald Trump on Friday suggested a trade deal with China could happen soon, as he thanked Apple for its plans to expand in the U.S. and said talks with North Korea were proceeding “just fine.”
CHINA TRADE TWEET
In an apparent reference to China’s agreeing to cut tariffs on U.S. automobiles , Trump tweeted that China has “just suspended U.S. Tariff Hikes,” and asserted that move could lead to a bigger agreement.
Related: China cutting U.S. auto tariffs is big news — for German auto makers
“China wants to make a big and very comprehensive deal. It could happen, and rather soon!” the president said.
Weaker-than-expected economic data from China and Europe weighed on investors Friday, sending U.S. stocks DJIA, -2.02% down sharply.
Also see: Treasurys rally after soft China data sends global stocks lower .
PRAISE FOR APPLE
After Apple’s Thursday announcement it was building a campus in Austin, Texas, Trump thanked the company’s AAPL, -3.20% Chief Executive Tim Cook on Twitter “for agreeing to expand operations in the U.S. and thereby creating thousands of jobs!”
The campus plan isn’t actually a new hiring announcement, as Apple had in January announced plans to hire 20,000 workers.
Read: Apple announced more new, permanent jobs than any other company this year .
NO HURRY ON NORTH KOREA
Also on Twitter, Trump said the U.S. is in “no hurry” in its nuclear talks with North Korea. Pyongyang has blamed the Trump administration for stalling talks since meetings with American officials were canceled last month.
Trump wrote that many people have asked him how negotiations are going. “I always reply by saying we are in no hurry, there is wonderful potential for great economic success for that country,” the president said. He continued by saying North Korean leader Kim Jong Un “sees it better than anyone and will fully take advantage of it for his people. We are doing just fine!”
Opinion: North Korea’s Kim Jong Un continues to outmaneuver Donald Trump .
Separately, Trump spoke with Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan, White House press secretary Sarah Sanders said. Turkey has threatened to mount a new incursion into northern Syria , in a move that has raised U.S. concerns. Sanders said Trump and Erdogan “agreed to continue coordinating to achieve our respective security objectives in Syria.”
